name: Disney's Grand Californian Storytellers Cafe Carved Turkey, Prime Rib, Salmon, Rice & Mickey Waffles
brandOrRestaurant: Storytellers Cafe (Disney's Grand Californian Hotel & Spa · Disneyland Resort)
whyItWorks: With its private entrance right into Disney California Adventure, Storytellers Cafe's carving station and made-to-order omelet bar let you eat clean carved turkey breast, prime rib (trim outer fat), baked salmon, mashed potatoes, white rice, scrambled eggs, and allergy-friendly Mickey waffles.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Head to the carving station for lean roasted turkey or center-cut prime rib with mashed potatoes and cooked carrots, or ask your server for freshly made dairy-free/gluten-free Mickey waffles and a plain ham & cheddar omelet.
watchOuts: Skip creamy horseradish sauce, raw salad bar veggies, and seeded berry desserts
